objections_en: The judge's reasoning relies on ws-5 (BBC News), which is categorized as NOT_A_SOURCE. While the information is correct and corroborated by other sources, a verdict should not be primarily based on a source of this tier.

The confidence of 95 is slightly too high given the reliance on a NOT_A_SOURCE and the minor discrepancy in GMT time reported by Al Jazeera (ws-8, 12:30 GMT) and Space.com (ws-7, 1:34 p.m. GMT), even though the latter was a prediction.
